items.name: Axial Age
items.why: A current for the Historical Currents layer: the centuries of the Buddha, Confucius, the Hebrew prophets and Greek philosophy (Jaspers' contested label). Would include life-of-the-buddha, birth-of-confucius, platos-academy-founded.

items.name: Age of Enlightenment
items.why: A current for the Historical Currents layer; the Scientific Revolution influenced it and it influenced the Declaration of Independence and the Rights of Man.

items.name: Decolonization of Asia and Africa
items.why: A current for the Historical Currents layer; would hold India's, Indonesia's and Ghana's independence, the Year of Africa, the Algerian War and Bandung, with World War II as one cause.
